call "C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\Community\Common7\Tools\VsDevCmd.bat" -arch=x64 -host_arch=x64 >nul
if errorlevel 1 exit /b %errorlevel%
cl /nologo /O2 /MD /std:c17 /utf-8 /W4 out/p2-clipboard-station.c /Foout/p2-clipboard-station.obj /Feout/p2-clipboard-station.exe /link user32.lib

from pathlib import Path
root=Path('D:/NexaUI');source=(root/'tests/test_clipboard.c').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
cases=[('current', '!(flags.dwFlags & WSF_VISIBLE) && _wcsicmp(before, after) != 0', '1'),('busy','return CloseClipboard() && empty;','return CloseClipboard() && (empty || GetClipboardOwner() == hwnd);'),('reuse','if (!fixture->station && create_error == ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS)','if (0)')]
for name,old,new in cases:

import json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('D:/NexaUI');report=[]
for name,args,expected,marker in [('current',['reject-current-station'],1,None),('busy',['reject-busy'],1,'reject busy isolated clipboard without changing sentinel'),('reuse',[],77,'isolated station/desktop unavailable')]:
 run=subprocess.run([str(root/'out'/f'p2-clipboard-{name}.exe'),*args],capture_output=True)
 (root/'out/p2-clipboard'/f'negative-{name}.stdout').write_bytes(run.stdout)
 (root/'out/p2-clipboard'/f'negative-{name}.stderr').write_bytes(run.stderr)
 assert run.returncode==expected,(name,run.returncode,run.stderr)
 if marker:assert marker in run.stderr.decode()
 report.append(dict(name=name,args=args,exit_code=run.returncode,expected=expected,precise_rejection=marker or 'Guard-current mode returned1 before clipboard access'))
(root/'out/p2-clipboard/negative-controls.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print(report)
